'''Amalisa Jagad''' is the sister of [[Agelmar Jagad]], the Lord of [[Fal Dara]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is short and middle aged, with a dark mature beauty.

==History==
Her nickname for [[Easar Togita|King Easar]] is Magami or "Little Uncle."

==Activities==
She was blackmailed while under [[Compulsion]] by [[Liandrin]], who suggested that it might come out that Agelmar was a [[Darkfriend]] and that they would be dragged in the streets naked.

She had her maidservants search Fal Dara keep for [[Rand al'Thor]], but they could not find him because he was hiding in the women's quarters.

== In the television series ==
In the television series, Lady {{TVlink|Amalisa Jagad}} is played by {{TVlink|Sandra Yi Sencindiver}}
